{{Top|leg}}
'''Aiden''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]]. Aiden was once hired to stun a prominent [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[operative]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Aiden used a dart shooter to fire a [[Dart/Legends|dart]] tipped with [[Poison/Legends|poison]] to knock out the target. Aiden was cannily aware that the client would turn on them, and got off-planet before the clients could kill them. Aiden kept the dart shooter as a constant reminder that some deals were too good to be true. Aiden commented on several entries in the Datalog, such as the [[LaserHone/Legends|LaserHone]] [[Talon vibrodagger]], [[dart shooter]], [["Renegade" heavy blaster pistol/Legends|Renegade heavy blaster pistol]], and the [[X-45 sniper rifle]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
